headline: Granite Plastics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Granite Plastics reported revenue growth of 22% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Granite Plastics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Granite Plastics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Granite Plastics labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Granite Plastics. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Court freezes assets of Granite Plastics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Granite Plastics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Granite Plastics cuts guidance after margin squeeze
